question: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only F is kept above A. Only two boxes are kept between A and D. Only B is kept below C. G is not kept immediately above D. How many boxes are kept between B and E?
solution:
Given : Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only F is kept above A.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between A and D.
 
• Only B is kept below C.
 
• G is not kept immediately above D

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
F
